Congratulations to our dedicated NAPWU BIPA Negotiating Team on successfully concluding the 2026/2027 Wage Inflationary Adjustment Agreement. Your commitment and determination have once again delivered meaningful gains for workers.
For the first time ever, a 33% employer contribution towards Medical Aid has been introduced as part of the negotiated agreement—a landmark achievement for employee welfare.
